description:
Turn your voice into polished text.

Ultra-fast AI powered dictation that understands what you want to say and how you want to say it. Instantly turn speech into perfect emails, crisp notes, clear messages, professional communication, and more.
Features
- Meeting mode records your calls with mic and system audio, transcribes them live with speaker labels, and writes a summary when you're done
- Meeting templates shape your summaries, with favorites and an editor for making your own
- Meetings tab to search, filter and revisit past meetings, with a "Happening now" card while one is recording
- Superwhisper can spot a call starting in Zoom, Teams, Slack, Webex or a browser meeting, and offer to record it or start automatically
- Share a meeting as a link, or export it as Markdown or HTML
- Search a meeting's transcript, play it back, rename speakers, and @mention them in your notes
- Qwen and Aya local language models
- Mechanical sound theme
- Recording details show how long each step took, from upload to the result coming back
Improvements
- Settings sidebar reorganized to match macOS, with Shortcuts in its own tab
- Left-click the tray icon to open settings, and right-click for a menu that matches macOS
- S1-Voice real-time in Message mode shows formatted text as you speak and finishes faster when you stop
- Very long S1-Voice real-time recordings keep their live text and only transcribe what came after the time limit
- Long meeting transcripts now fit into S1-Language summaries instead of failing
- Local language models handle longer prompts, and offer to switch to a cloud model when a prompt is too big
- Home lets you know when a slow connection is holding up your recordings
- Numbered lists keep their numbering when pasted
- Trailing full stops are only kept when your mode asks for them
- The prompt in recording details collapses to a one-click copy
- Polished menus, pickers and What's New cards
Fixes
- Models in the model picker no longer become unclickable due to scroll limits
- Editing or reprocessing a recording no longer fails to save in some cases
- The recording waveform no longer breaks after long use
- If startup fails, the tray menu still lets you quit instead of getting stuck loading
